the_finding: THE ONE FIXTURE NOTHING EVER COMPARED IS THE ONE THAT HAD DRIFTED. All eleven CHAINED bodies are IDENTICAL or NUMBERING-ONLY with zero instructions moved, exactly as at the two earlier producers. The TWELFTH committed fixture -- level_is_zero_deref_callee, read verbatim by crystal_a1_lineage/level_is_zero.rs and in no table any comparison ever walked -- came back STRUCTURAL on its first ever comparison. On inspection the body is INTACT: six instructions, same opcodes, same operands, and the `const u64 34` carrying the addressed string's LENGTH byte-identical. What moved is THREE whole-crate index tables, one of which the classifier did not model: functy 53->45, @func 8369->7170 and 7675->6477, and @global 4527->4524. `global-index` is now the fifth AMBER class, with the same justification and the same stated limitation as `callee-index` -- and the verdict is NUMBERING-ONLY.
what_this_run_does_not_claim: A `@global.N` (like a `@func.N`) is an INDEX; the module text carries no declaration under that name (globals print as @__trust_promoted_N), so this comparison does NOT re-derive WHICH global is addressed. It establishes that the instruction, its operand shape and the accompanying length constant are unchanged, and that no gate lane reads the index. That is why it is AMBER and not GREEN, and it is the honest strength of the claim.
